resources.string: Screen privacy shield for WhatsApp and sensitive apps

Used strictly to detect when a protected application (such as WhatsApp) opens in the foreground so Privacy Blur can automatically display the privacy overlay. Privacy Blur does NOT read, inspect, store, or transmit your messages, keystrokes, or screen content.
